blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has extended the Oct. 26 deadline to Oct. 29 for the filing of tax returns and payment of corresponding taxes under BIR Form No. 2550Q — the Quarterly Value-Added Tax Return — and BIR Form No. 2551Q — Quarterly Percentage Tax Return), including the submission of required attachments. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 115-2026, signed by Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza, the extension was granted due to the unavailability of the Electronic Filing and Payment System (eFPS).
